ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Capabilities Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to discover the files with setuid/setgid capability on them. That would allow adversary to escalate their privileges. Note: Unmapped fields: type, a0, a1, a2

sequences.query: (type = "EXECVE" AND a0 = "getcap" AND a1 = "\-r" AND a2 = "\/")
